thread:
marta: FYI discovered ~120 CI debug artifacts uploaded to partner-error-bucket that contain Vault transit wrappers (strings like 'vault:v1:...'). Appears the telemetry CI's debug step archived raw job output without filtering. Need immediate containment + rotation plan.

sam: ouch. Can you paste a couple of object keys and one sample header (no plaintext)?

marta: keys: telemetry-ci/pr-4982/debug-20260319-0211.dump, telemetry-ci/pr-4983/trace-20260319-0228.log, telemetry-ci/pr-4979/wrapped-blob-20260319.bin
sample header: 'vault:v1:8f2d4a...b7c'

jia: containment priorities (first 60):
- remove objects from partner-error-bucket
- disable the CI SA keys that performed the uploads
- revoke any Vault leases issued to that CI service account
- pull KMS/Vault audit entries for Decrypt/Unwrap in the window

devops-sre: running deletes now. Commands: 
- aws s3 rm s3://partner-error-bucket/telemetry-ci/ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "pr-4*" --dryrun && then run without dryrun
- gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID --iam-account=telemetry-ci@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- vault lease revoke -prefix=telemetry-ci/  (enumerating leases)
I'll post back with counts.

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-4407 created and sec-oncall paged.

jia: when you have deletes done, export cloud audit for: google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt and kms.crypto.Decrypt events. Need caller, service account, and source IP.

marta: exporting logs to gs://security-evidence/INC-2026-4407/. Example queries posted to ticket.

sam: transit-key plan: rotate the transit key bound to staging telemetry, then revoke previous key version so leaked wrappers cannot be unwrapped by our key version. Steps: 
- vault write -f transit/keys/staging-telemetry/rotate
- update any rewrap policies and run a rewrap job for retained ciphertext we control
- mark any long-lived tokens that rely on that key for rotation
Question: will rotation impact prod?

marta: confirmed the affected key is used only by staging/telemetry CI. Prod uses a separate transit key. Low blast radius.

devops-sre: completed deletion: 121 objects removed. Disabled 2 SA keys. Revoked 6 active leases. Pushed audit exports.

oncall-bot: sec-oncall assigned to sam.

sam: Owner tasks (24h):
1) rotate transit key (performed after 5m freeze)
2) schedule rewrap of archives and scrub backups that reference old wrappers
3) land CI sanitizer to avoid uploading wrappers (PR telemetry-ci#523)
4) RBAC fix: deny PutObject to partner-error-bucket from CI SA; introduce object allowlist and least-priv write role
5) prepare partner notification and sync with partnerships once we confirm no unwraps

jia: I'll run audit analysis and post Decrypt/Unwrap caller details to INC-2026-4407. Also recommend creating a file-scan alert that flags any object containing the substring 'vault:v1:' on upload.

marta: drafting partner message: 'We detected debug outputs containing wrapped tokens, removed the artifacts, rotated our staging transit key, and disabled the CI keys that uploaded them. We're analyzing audit logs to confirm there were no unwraps and will follow up with a timeline and remediation.'

sam: approved. Please send after we confirm audit results.

devops-sre: transit key rotation done; rewrap job queued for off-peak hours. CI PR to sanitize artifacts opened and linked in INC-2026-4407.

marta: quick checklist: 
- [x] remove objects from partner-error-bucket
- [x] disable CI SA keys
- [x] revoke Vault leases associated with telemetry CI
- [x] rotate staging transit key
- [ ] verify no KMS Decrypt/Unwrap events in audit logs (jia)
- [ ] enforce CI upload sanitizer and RBAC fix (devops-sre)
- [ ] send partner notification after audit confirms no unwraps (sam)

jia: I'll close out the audit findings by EOD and update the incident.

sam: thanks all. Will follow-up with a postmortem and RBAC hardening tickets. :thumbsup:
